description: Department of Local Government - Mr. M. N. Ranjan was elected as the Deputy Chairman of the Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the election of a Vice-Chairman for a local government authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Government Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with electoral processes and results at the local government level, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters including candidate elections and declarations.
